# Qualpalr help fixture

`autopal-deprecated.Rd` is an unchanged copy from qualpalr commit
`76381b8094585b6b7b0f8ccf14289e0abc51774d`. It is distributed under qualpalr's
GPL-3 license, included in `LICENSE`.

Tests copy this standalone deprecated topic into temporary workspaces. Minimal
local topics supply its help-link targets. The tests cover argument and return
documentation, prose, links, and rendering from a snapshot after removing the
source workspace.
